messages:
Nina Gomez: Quick follow-up from the postmortem thread about recurring cold-start latency tails. We need concrete SLO edits + an action plan to stop weekly p99 spikes. Summarizing owners here.
Theo Martin: Thanks. Can you call out the exact metric windows we want to change? I want to make sure alert noise doesn't explode.
Nina Gomez: Current observed: baseline p95 ~110ms, p99 jumps to 480-550ms during cold starts. Incidents occurred 5x in last 30 days, correlated with scale-up churn. Proposed: p95 <= 140ms (30d rolling), p99 <= 320ms (tiered: dedicated=300ms, hosted=350ms). Also add a burst window SLI: 5m p99 during autoscale <= 400ms.
Rina Chen: OK for tiering. Proposal: keep p95 global, p99 tiered. Need to update SLA verbiage for Dedicated customers to include burst windows. I'll draft.
Theo Martin: Owning root-cause mitigation: will investigate cold-pool routing + instance init hooks. Plan: triage (3d), small change (soft-warm startup + jitter) (1w), canary (2d), roll (2d).
Nina Gomez: Good. Rina -> dashboards/alerts. Theo -> runtime fixes. I'll coordinate customer comms and SLA doc update with legal.
ops-bot: Alert 2470001001: p99_latency > 400ms for 15m in prod-us-west triggered 3 times in past 24h.
Rina Chen: For alerts, propose a new alert rule:
```
alert: HighTailLatency
expr: increase(p99_request_duration_ms[10m]) > 0 and (p99_request_duration_ms > 320)
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "p99 latency > 320ms for 10m (tiered)
```
I'll make a non-page variant at 350ms for hosted to reduce noise.
Theo Martin: Will also add a short-circuit in runtime to keep RPC fanout bounded during warmup. PoC timeline in GH issue.
Nina Gomez: Action items (owners + dates):
- Rina: PR with dashboard panels + alert rules by Tue EOD (GH: redwood/observability).
- Theo: PoC for warm startup + routing fix by next Fri. Add benchmark script.
- Nina: Draft SLA addendum for Dedicated by Wed, coordinate with legal.
- oncall rotation: add tail-check to daily handoff checklist.
Rina Chen: I'll include a compare panel: p99 vs instance_boot_count and autoscale events. PromQL sample I'll add: ```histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))```
Theo Martin: I also want to add a synthetic test hitting cold pool at scale to reproduce. Will add to infra/ci (job: cold-start-smoke). ETA Thu.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for 2026-04-08 02:00 UTC (rollback window 2h).
Nina Gomez: Let's have a short 20-min sync Fri 10am PT to review PRs, PoC results, and canary plan. If anyone hits a blocker, ping me and tag @oncall. :thumbsup:
Rina Chen: Noted. I'll open the GH PR and link here when ready.
Theo Martin: Starting triage now, will attach logs to GH issue (redwood/runtime#589).
Nina Gomez: Thanks team. We'll track progress in the SLO sprint board and close action items when PRs are merged and the canary is green.
